name: Alcatraz Main Prison (the cellhouse)
note: Appearance audit 2026-10-02: was a generic brick block. Pale weathered concrete, tall barred windows, the skylight monitor (src/render/landmarks/sf/alcatraz.ts).

name: Alcatraz Guard Gallery (part of the cellhouse)
Alcatraz Island Lighthouse
note: 1909, 26 m: a white octagonal tower tapering to a black lantern. Was a 4 m-square apartment block 26 m tall.

name: Building 64
note: The barracks at the dock (1905). 2026-10-16: own model from Commons "Building 64, Alcatraz.jpg" — cream concrete, two-tier gallery on struts, the UNITED STATES PENITENTIARY board and INDIANS WELCOME, bookstore pavilions. Was a presidio restyle.

name: Alcatraz Dining Hall
note: 2026-10-06: stucco → presidio (the stucco style's ground floor is GARAGES, and Alcatraz has no cars — owner). Grey: a prison building (owner, 2026-10-06: 'the prison buildings are gray, the non-prison buildings like the power station are white').

name: Alcatraz Quartermaster
note: 2026-10-06: stucco → presidio (the stucco style's ground floor is GARAGES, and Alcatraz has no cars — owner).

name: Alcatraz Water Tower
note: 1940 steel tank on braced legs, the occupation's red lettering (restored 2012). Was a plain building.

name: Administration Block (Alcatraz)
note: Alcatraz audit 2026-10-04: the island's buildings are grey-cream concrete with flat roofs (NPS); the cellhouse's front block — was brick. 2026-10-06: stucco → presidio (the stucco style's ground floor is GARAGES, and Alcatraz has no cars — owner). Grey: a prison building (owner, 2026-10-06: 'the prison buildings are gray, the non-prison buildings like the power station are white').

name: Warden's House (ruins)
note: Burned out 1970. 2026-10-16: a roofless three-storey stucco shell, open windows, shaped Mission gables (Commons category Alcatraz Warden's House); was a whole presidio-restyle building.

name: Post Exchange & Officers' Club (ruins)
